recentDiary.text: Explored again. Found nothing new. More bored this time. Still curious, though.
Rested for a bit. Not tired. I feel fine. Don't know what to do next.
Listened outside. Crickets sounding. Heard them before. I feel good. Still curious.
Walked around town again. Saw nothing new. Bored more than before. Not tired.
